Privacy Policy for PDF Lite: Image to PDF

Last updated: September 25, 2026

PDF Lite: Image to PDF ("we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your information. This Privacy Policy explains how information is handled when you use our mobile application.

Application ID: com.pdflite.imagetopdf.bnqeye

Core Principle: Your documents and images are processed locally on your device for the application's document-processing features. We do not operate external servers for processing, storing, or viewing your documents.

1. Document & File Handling

PDF Lite: Image to PDF is designed to provide document productivity features primarily through on-device processing.

  • Local Processing: Features such as image-to-PDF conversion, PDF reading, merging, splitting, compression, page rotation, watermarking, password protection, page reordering, and OCR processing are performed locally on your Android device.
  • No Cloud Document Uploads: We do not upload, transmit, store, view, or monitor your personal photos, PDF documents, or generated document files on our own external servers.
  • Local Application Data: Information such as recent document lists, bookmarks, favorites, and other application metadata may be stored locally on your device. This information is not transferred to our servers.

2. Third-Party Services & Data Collection

We do not directly collect or store personal identifiers such as your name, phone number, or postal address through the application's document-processing features.

However, the application uses certain third-party services that may process technical information according to their own privacy policies.

A. Google Mobile Ads (AdMob)

The application uses Google AdMob to display advertisements. Depending on applicable settings, consent choices, device configuration, and regional requirements, Google may process information such as:

  • Advertising Identifier: Google Advertising ID (AAID), where applicable.
  • Network Information: Information such as IP address may be processed by Google for advertising, security, fraud prevention, and approximate regional purposes.
  • Advertising Information: Information relating to ad requests, impressions, interactions, and advertising performance may be processed.
  • Diagnostics: Certain technical or diagnostic information may be processed by Google services.

For more information about Google's privacy practices, please visit: Google Privacy Policy

B. Google User Messaging Platform (UMP)

The application may use Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) to display and manage privacy and advertising consent choices where required. Consent preferences may be stored or processed by Google according to its applicable policies.

C. Google ML Kit - Text Recognition

The application may use Google ML Kit for text recognition (OCR). The text-recognition functionality is designed to process images or documents on the device. We do not upload OCR images or extracted document content to our own servers for processing.

3. Device Permissions

The application may request permissions or system access necessary for its features. Depending on the Android version and the features being used, these may include:

  • android.permission.INTERNET: Used for services such as loading advertisements and communicating with applicable third-party services.
  • android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: Used to determine network connectivity status.
  • com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID: Used by Google advertising services where applicable for advertising-related functionality.
  • android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: On supported older Android versions, this may be used to access user-selected photos or documents stored on the device.

On newer Android versions, the application may use Android's system file picker, Storage Access Framework, MediaStore, or other privacy-preserving system APIs instead of broad storage access.

4. Data Retention, Security & Deletion

  • User Files: Files created, selected, or processed by the application remain under the user's control on the device unless the user chooses to share, move, or otherwise export them.
  • Application Data: Locally stored application metadata may be removed by deleting the relevant records, clearing application data, or uninstalling the application, subject to Android system behavior.
  • Temporary Files: Temporary previews or working files may be stored locally while certain features are being used and can be removed through the application's available cache or cleanup controls.

5. Children's Privacy

PDF Lite: Image to PDF is not specifically directed toward children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 through our own services.

Third-party services integrated into the application, such as advertising services, may have their own age-related requirements and privacy practices.

6. Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect information handled by the application. Because document processing is performed locally, documents processed by the application are not sent to our own document-processing servers.

Users should also maintain appropriate security on their Android device, including screen locks and operating-system security updates.

7. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to the application, third-party services, legal requirements, or Google Play policies.

When changes are made, the updated policy will be published on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.

8. Contact Us

If you have questions, feedback, or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or the application's privacy practices, please contact us:
